name: Place an order from a cart with an updated quantity
description: Raising a quantity in the cart must carry through checkout to the confirmation. Kiln has one flat shipping rate, so there is no shipping option to choose.

planSteps.description: On the shop page, click "Add to cart" for Speckled Mug once
Click the Cart link in the store header
Click the plus button on the Speckled Mug line once
The Speckled Mug line shows quantity 2 and the Total row reads exactly $43.00
Fill Full name with Ada Lovelace, Email with ada@example.com, Street address with 12 Analytical St and Postal code with SW1A 1AA, then click Place order
The confirmation page says Order placed and lists Speckled Mug × 2
The Total charged amount reads exactly $43.00
